decisionsTitle: «Lista publică și clasamentul»: the public-list choice in a block of its own on the manage page and «Înscrierile mele» (amending §143's and §186's presentation, not their rule)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20**, of the participant's own page and its public-list switch: «trebuie ca asta sa fie mai vizibila». The switch (§143) was a sentence and an outlined button lost among the page's other sections — under the race-day block, the declaration line and «Completează-ți datele»; on a family's page with no heading at all; on «Înscrierile mele» a small text button under the cancel. It is the one place a person controls a disclosure of their name (CLAUDE.md: a public participant list is a disclosure, not a display option), so it has to be found. The owner asked for it to be seen, not for other words: the choice keeps its name.

**Decision: a block of its own, for every registration** (`registrations/ui/PublicListChoice.tsx`, drawn on «Gestionează înscrierea» for every person on the page — a family's page included — and on «Înscrierile mele» for each registration; its words in one place for both pages, `registrations/ui/public-list-choice-words.ts`). It changes how the choice is drawn, never its rule: the tick stays the person's own, off unless they gave it, written by the one function (`list-consent.ts#setListConsent`) with its audit row.

- **A box that stands out without alarming**: the info notices' tint (MUI `Alert` info's own background, through its CSS variable, so both colour schemes follow), the divider's border, the cards' corners — never an error or a warning colour: it is a choice, not a problem.
- **A heading on every registration**: «Lista publică și clasamentul» / “Public list and results” on a race — one tick for the list and the results (§570, §808) — and the list's own title, «Lista publică de participanți» / “The public participant list” (the confirmation email's page wears it), on an event that takes no results; `h2` on a one-person page, `h4` inside a family's person card, `h3` on «Înscrierile mele».
- **The state in bold beside the eye**, open when the name is shown, crossed when it is not, saying only what the public list and the results draw (`domain/list-choice.ts#listChoiceState`, one rule for both pages):
  - On the list: «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților și în clasament.» only where the published results would print the name — the results' own rule, `publicResultName`, asked with the tick on and the registration confirmed and shown: a race, a privacy notice describing the results, the registration made under it or a later one, or asked since by «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» (§879). Elsewhere «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților.», so the page never says «în clasament» while the results print «Participant #…» — the older notice's runner, whose own question is on the same page.
  - Off the list: «Numele tău nu apare pe lista publică a participanților și nici în clasament: pe listă apari ca „Participant (nume ascuns)”.» — the label read from the public list's own words (`Event.startList.anonymous`), never retyped — only where the list draws that row (§186, `countAnonymousStartListEntries`): a confirmed registration inside the places — not one on «Lista de invitați speciali», which the list never draws off it (§743) — on an event whose list is shown now, `NAMES` and inside the club's days after the event (§421). A pending or waiting registration off the list is not on it at all, a special guest off it neither, and an event that publishes no list (the default) draws no row: there it says «Numele tău nu apare pe lista publică a participanților și nici în clasament.». «și nici în clasament» only on a race, where it is true whatever the notices say; an event that takes no results never names a ranking.
- **One button, the same in both states**: contained, the primary colour, large, at least 48 pixels tall and the full width of a phone, its eye the answer it gives, the words in sentence case and the tick's own both ways — «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» / «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» (§570), the words the confirmation email's page says and the club's message to the runners (§613) told them to press. Withdrawing is exactly as easy and as visible as appearing (art. 7(3) GDPR): nothing pre-chosen, no colour that shames either answer, no wording that pushes. It is the house's `SubmitButton`, so a press says «Salvăm alegerea…» and is not sent twice.
- **One line under it**: «Poți schimba oricând, de aici sau din „Înscrierile mele”.»; on «Înscrierile mele» itself «Poți schimba oricând, de aici sau din pagina înscrierii.».

**Placed where the eye lands.** On the manage page right under the registration's state, number and QR with its «Sunt aici» line — before the declaration line, «Completează-ți datele», the offers, the results' question, the raffle, «Vii la …?» and the cancel; `#list` stays on the link's own person's block, where every press lands. On «Înscrierile mele» under the QR and «Sunt aici», before the cancel and the offers.

**Nothing else changes**: the write and its audit row, the three doors and their actions (their redirects too: a press on the manage page lands at `#list`, the link's own person's block, as before — a press in another person's block of a family's page as well, its answer drawn in that person's block), the confirmation email's own link and its page (`/inregistrari/lista/…`, its words kept), the results' older-notice question where it was (after the offers), every staff verb and every public page. The reads carry the block's display facts with what they already read: the manage page's `token-actions.ts#readRaceDayContext` takes the event's whole row (the same one query) for `listShown`, and `manage-family.ts#listManagedPeople` selects each person's `outside_capacity`; «Înscrierile mele»'s `my-registrations.ts` selects the event's list switch and its end beside its other columns and hands on the `outside_capacity` it already read. The words `Registrations.list.choice.*` are new in both catalogues; `list.shortListed` and `list.shortNotListed`, which only the two pages read, are gone; the guide and «Sarcini» name the way out as they did, and it is the button's again.

**Refused.** A red or amber box, or a coloured «Nu vreau» — it would shame one answer. A switch or a tick in place of the button: on these pages the press is the save, and a tick reads as a form still to send. New words for the way out («Nu vreau să apar pe listă și în clasament»): the email's page, §570 and the club's messages name the button by its words, and three doors to one choice must not name it two ways. «Participant (nume ascuns)» for everybody off the list — false for a pending registration, for a special guest and on an event that publishes no list. «… și în clasament» on every listed registration — false for the older notice's runner and before any notice describes the results — and any word of results on an event that takes none. Moving the block above the QR: on race day the code is what the person opens the page for.
changelogLine: - **The public-list choice stands out** — on «Gestionează înscrierea» (every person of a family's page too) and «Înscrierile mele», «Lista publică și clasamentul» is a tinted box of its own right under the QR: the state in bold beside the eye, «Participant (nume ascuns)» named where the public list draws the row so, and one full-width button that looks the same whichever way it goes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a registration still registered, when «Gestionează înscrierea» renders it — alone or as one person of a family's page — or «Înscrierile mele» lists it, then its public-list choice is a block of its own headed «Lista publică și clasamentul» / “Public list and results” on a race and «Lista publică de participanți» / “The public participant list” on an event that takes no results (`h2` alone, `h4` in a family's card, `h3` on «Înscrierile mele»), in the info notices' tint with the divider's border, on «Gestionează înscrierea» right under the registration's state, number and QR with «Sunt aici» and before the declaration line, the offers and the cancel, and on «Înscrierile mele» after the QR and «Sunt aici» and before the cancel and the offers; the state is bold beside an open eye when listed and a crossed eye when not, and `#list` is on the manage link's own person's block only (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/family-screens.test.ts`.

Given that block, when the name is on the list, then it reads «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților și în clasament.» only where `publicResultName` would print the name for the registration ticked and confirmed — a race, a privacy notice describing the results, the registration under it or a later one, or asked since by «Vreau să apar cu numele în clasament» — and «Numele tău apare pe lista publică a participanților.» otherwise; when it is off the list, then it reads «Numele tău nu apare pe lista publică a participanților», with «și nici în clasament» only on a race and «: pe listă apari ca „Participant (nume ascuns)”» (the public list's own label) only for a confirmed registration inside the places on an event whose list is shown now — `NAMES`, inside the club's days after the event — never for a pending or waiting one, one on «Lista de invitați speciali» or on an event that publishes no list, and in English the same sentences from the English catalogue (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `registrations/list-choice.test.ts`, integration `registrations/family-screens.test.ts`.

Given that block in either state, when it renders, then it carries one contained, primary, large submit button at least 48 pixels tall and the full width of a 320-pixel screen, in the tick's own words as criterion 23 has them — «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» off the list, «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» on it — with the same classes and the same fill both ways; one press through the manage link or «Înscrierile mele» sets the answer, says «Am reținut alegerea ta.», writes the participant's audit row through its door and spends no link, and nothing overflows at 320 pixels (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: e2e `manage-list-choice.spec.ts`.

batchLine: the public-list choice in a block of its own on the manage page and «Înscrierile mele»
